messages:
Dana: FYI team 7 we're kicking off a migration to vault-backed CI secrets and GitHub OIDC for runners. Goal: remove long-lived repo secrets and PATs from CI infra. Migration page: https://go/redwood/ci-auth-vault (read before you act)

Omar: When does enforcement start? Any blast radius we should be aware of?

Dana: Canary week starts Mon May 3 (infra/*, tooling/*). Org-wide enforcement planned Fri May 7 09:00 PT. No infra outage expected but some workflows will fail if they still reference repo secrets. We'll publish failure lists during the canary.

Priya: What about third-party actions that only accept PATs?

Infra-Lee: We'll offer org-scoped fine-grained tokens via the broker as a temporary escape hatch. Add known actions to the compatibility sheet in the migration doc.

QA-Kim: Any impact to release pipelines? We have a freeze May 5-9.

Dana: We'll exclude repos labeled `release/hold` from the canary and enforcement during the freeze. Owners: DM me exact repo names.

Omar: How do service accounts and k8s jobs get credentials?

Infra-Lee: Use OIDC annotations or the new vault-agent init container. Example in doc. We'll also provide a small operator to refresh tokens for long-lived processes.

Priya: Local dev note: nothing changes for `gh auth login`. To run workflows that need CI secrets locally, install `ci-vault-cli` and run `ci-vault-cli login`. We'll add a short README to affected repos.

engbot: Checklist created: https://go/redwood/checklists/ci-auth-migration  add your repo via `add: <repo>` on the checklist.

Dana: Action items: add repos to checklist, run `./scripts/check-ci-auth.sh <repo>` (returns PASS/FAIL), file exceptions by Apr 28 for special compliance needs. I'll post daily status through the canary.

Omar: Thanks Dana  I'll scan our org and add any exceptions.

Priya: Thanks, team. :thumbsup:
